name: 희소 표현 분석
description: Uses sparse coding and dictionary learning to detect representation anomalies in AI images (Wright et al., 2009).
mechanism:
이 방법은 applies sparse representation theory following Wright et al. (2009) and Elad & Aharon (2006) 포렌식 분석을 위해:

1. **DictionaryLearning**: A redundant dictionary D ∈ ℝⁿˣᴷ (K >> n, overcomplete) is learned from natural image patches via K-SVD algorithm. Each atom captures a characteristic local structure (edge, texture, smooth region) found in authentic images.

2. **SparseCoding**: For each image patch y, the sparsest representation α is found via: min‖α‖₀ s.t. ‖y − Dα‖₂ ≤ ε. In practice, OMP (Orthogonal Matching Pursuit) or LASSO provides an approximate solution. Natural image patches admit highly sparse representations (few active atoms).

3. **RepresentationResidual분석**: The residual r = ‖y − Dα‖₂ measures how well each patch fits the natural image dictionary. Authentic image patches yield low residuals, while AI 생성 patches — containing artifacts outside the natural image manifold — produce elevated residuals.

4. **SparsityMapConstruction**: A spatial map of sparsity levels (‖α‖₀) and residuals across the image reveals regions 일관성 없는 with natural image statistics. Manipulated or AI 생성 regions 일반적으로 require more dictionary atoms (lower sparsity) yet still produce higher residuals.

5. **이상점수 산출**: The joint distribution of sparsity and residuals across all patches is compared to the expected distribution for natural images. Systematic deviations — particularly elevated residuals in textured regions that should be well-represented by the learned dictionary — indicate synthetic generation.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적

references.title: Wright, J. et al. (2009). Robust Face Recognition via Sparse Representation. IEEE TPAMI.
Elad, M. & Aharon, M. (2006). Image Denoising via Sparse and Redundant Representations. IEEE TIP.
